sample_method: Every cloth vertex, unique edge midpoint and triangle centroid queried against exact closest physical teddy triangles. Material patches use original rest surface face centroids; this is not continuous collision/contact-force analysis.

low_region.scope: Only points below every rim vertex and the virtual fan cap; cap exists for analysis only. Not whole-body final containment proof.

actual_physical_mouth.scope: Actual74-point body boundary. Projected width/area and fitted axes are descriptors, never containment or physical aperture proof.

limits: Actual snapshots and offline hypotheses are explicitly distinguished. Current native insertion is not replayed or replaced.
Virtual high caps exist for winding analysis only and are never physical bag surfaces.
A null low-region result means no query strictly below the lowest74-node rim minus2mm, not failed or successful containment.
Frozen endpoint body intersections quantify deformation needed, not predict the compliant native outcome.
